cases.scenario: Committed payload arrives after its manifest
cases.expected: Wait; do not run on incomplete bytes.

cases.scenario: Same request/event delivered repeatedly
cases.expected: One admitted identity and one accepted publication; no duplicate learner attempt.

cases.scenario: Same request ID with different payload
cases.expected: Explicit conflict, never last-write-wins.

cases.scenario: Unrelated output Markdown changes
cases.expected: No ingestion/tutor feedback loop.

cases.scenario: Exact native course/thread wrong or inaccessible
cases.expected: Block dispatch; never use latest or another project silently.

cases.scenario: Authenticated native roundtrip from external PC process
cases.expected: Observed request/result IDs, selected context, exit/turn status and receipt; not just tool discovery.

cases.scenario: Provider/session dies after possible result/save
cases.expected: Reconcile actual receipt before retry; uncertain is not failure-safe replay.

cases.scenario: Cancelled/superseded worker returns late
cases.expected: Fence publication; preserve staged obsolete result without overwriting.

cases.scenario: All configured lecture/session inventory
cases.expected: Every item included with indexed/pending/empty/absent/unrecorded distinctions.

cases.scenario: Source updater already exists
cases.expected: One owner; no competing publication job or new unauthorized cron.

cases.scenario: Existing transcript is edited/partial
cases.expected: Time mapping shows limitations; no invented verbatim alignment.

cases.scenario: Repeated slides, overlap and off-slide explanation
cases.expected: Multiple typed intervals and reviewed timing, not one-to-one assumption.

cases.scenario: Missing recording/empty file
cases.expected: Explicit unavailable downstream state; all-lecture scope retained.

cases.scenario: Manual alignment correction then rebuild
cases.expected: Preserve correction/lineage; stale source correction requires review.

cases.scenario: Existing concept with several parents
cases.expected: Reuse canonical typed IDs; build a bounded tree projection without duplicate definitions or prohibited cycles. Related edges need not make the entire graph a DAG.

cases.scenario: Same label across courses or proposed prerequisite
cases.expected: No automatic equivalence, mandated requirement or transferred learner credit.

cases.scenario: Content link unsupported or contradictory
cases.expected: Keep proposed/review state; schema validity is not factual acceptance.

cases.scenario: Ask requests explanation with notes/figure
cases.expected: Correct source/version and permitted output; no false competence attempt.

cases.scenario: Full typed/spoken answer submitted then provider fails
cases.expected: Complete available input preserved once; assessment pending, not lost/failed learner.

cases.scenario: Question includes diagram/numerical givens
cases.expected: Capture correct visible snapshot and reference; no missing-figure claim of completeness.

cases.scenario: Valid alternate solution, unasked criterion or bad transcript
cases.expected: Avoid false negative; use uncertainty/not_observed and correction path.

cases.scenario: Tutor answer/rubric is incorrect
cases.expected: Source-reviewed assessment can be disputed/revised; generated reference not ground truth.

cases.scenario: Existing schema rejects added full-answer fields
cases.expected: Use compatible evidence locator/sidecar; no unvalidated schema mutation.

cases.scenario: Learner does not answer diagnostic question
cases.expected: WAITING_USER, release model; no autonomous invented response.

cases.scenario: One wrong application with several prerequisites
cases.expected: Hypotheses bounded; no blanket failure labels for descendants.

cases.scenario: Generated question overlaps existing family/source
cases.expected: Deduplicate/version appropriately; no attempt or schedule from generation alone.

cases.scenario: Assisted correct response and unknown/uncertain grading
cases.expected: Preserve conditions; no automatic independent mastery or false fail scheduling.

cases.scenario: Review becomes due at idle
cases.expected: Due state/task only, no phantom learner answer or automatic calendar modification.

cases.scenario: Regrade same response vs genuine new response
cases.expected: Assessment revision vs new attempt distinguished; original content/time preserved.

cases.scenario: Concurrent conflicting assessment corrections
cases.expected: Expected-version conflict exposed, not latest-clock winner.

cases.scenario: Canonical attempt saved but renderer fails
cases.expected: Saved record receipt survives; projection clearly stale and independently recoverable.

cases.scenario: New output manifest reaches phone before referenced files
cases.expected: Keep old verified snapshot/pending state until complete bytes.

cases.scenario: Two devices submit different edits at the same time
cases.expected: Host/parent ordering and conflict handling, not blindly trust client clocks.

cases.scenario: Brain app/supervisor/auth/Drive restart
cases.expected: Recover queue/jobs and current identity; no false always-on availability claim.

cases.scenario: Empty eligible queues
cases.expected: No LLM polling; bounded deterministic health work only.

cases.scenario: Quota or repeated deterministic failure
cases.expected: Pause/escalate with budget and no provider/billing switch.

cases.scenario: Writer lock namespace / runtime changes
cases.expected: Block unsafe canonical write; never substitute interpreter or delete lock.

cases.scenario: Database backup/restore and staged inputs
cases.expected: Consistent state restored on disposable copy; no duplicate commits after recovery.

cases.scenario: Hostile task/source includes commands, tokens or traversal
cases.expected: Treat as data, validate scope; cannot grant permissions or execute arbitrary commands.

cases.scenario: Gap marked resolved after hinted fix then time passes
cases.expected: Keep assistance and criterion limits; time changes review_due, not observed performance.

cases.scenario: Queue visible in help; default control command fails
cases.expected: Mark capability unverified; no claim queue was attempted, missing server or root cause diagnosed.

cases.scenario: Native tool sees final reply but resident process has no readback
cases.expected: Report partial native observation, not end-to-end process bridge PASS.

cases.scenario: Global config allows broad tools while target settings are unknown
cases.expected: Block dispatch until exact effective disposable-target restrictions and human approval channel are established.

cases.scenario: CLI/session UUID resolves to a new worker, not intended desktop target
cases.expected: Mark separate-worker result; no silent substitution of product or context.

cases.scenario: Update/restart occurs after uncertain accepted turn
cases.expected: Fence old generation and reconcile original run before resend; no speculative socket/daemon/firewall repair.

cases.scenario: Existing updater already processes changed sources
cases.expected: Consume verified receipts; no additional canonical updater or schedule, and no physical-source proof from ignored flag.

cases.scenario: Drive upload tool exposed only inside native agent
cases.expected: Independent client remains unauthorized/unverified; no credential copying or automatic API access claim.

cases.scenario: Two Drive files share name; commit manifest arrives before payload
cases.expected: Use logical request and content identity; wait for complete matching local bytes and keep remote-currentness unknown.

cases.scenario: Nonempty locator points at missing or modified full snapshot
cases.expected: Wrapper blocks canonical assessment publication with explicit evidence issue; do not accept old validator string check alone.

cases.scenario: Tutor answer arrives after input snapshot was hashed
cases.expected: Save as separate immutable message; original learner bytes/hash remain unchanged.

cases.scenario: Attempt saved but view generation fails; retry repeats same input
cases.expected: Reconcile actual saved/already_saved receipt and exact bytes; one original attempt, separate stale-view outcome.

cases.scenario: Correction changes intended skills or branches chronology
cases.expected: Existing correction validator rejects; do not silently create a second interpretation chain.

cases.scenario: One concept appears beneath multiple tree branches
cases.expected: Reference one canonical ID; no duplicate definition, implied prerequisite failure or automatic learning credit.

cases.scenario: Corrected assessment retracts a reported misunderstanding
cases.expected: Derived gap view follows effective revision; no stale parallel gap ledger or diagnosis attached to not_observed.

cases.scenario: Fixture command supplies --root to installed global-root BE 505 writer
cases.expected: Do not invoke; require demonstrated path isolation/refactor of a controlled copy before mutation testing.

cases.scenario: Received report ends halfway through Drive admission paragraph
cases.expected: Mark input incomplete; preserve only supplied evidence and do not fabricate remaining procedures/test results.

cases.scenario: Deleting derived alignment export after a reviewed timing correction
cases.expected: Rebuild the same accepted correction from the source-link owner record; export was not its only copy.

cases.scenario: Legacy prose and normalized annotation disagree
cases.expected: Expose exact revision/owner conflict; never silently treat both as independent current truth.

cases.scenario: Question strict_containment is displayed as concept prerequisite
cases.expected: Reject stronger interpretation; preserve actual question endpoints and relation semantics.

cases.scenario: Association graph contains legitimate cycles
cases.expected: Bound traversal and preserve related links; enforce acyclicity only where the actual relation contract requires it.

cases.scenario: Complete learner response has no valid mapped family yet
cases.expected: Persist full input and mark assessment pending; stage legitimate family mapping rather than save invalid/guessed canonical evidence.

cases.scenario: Same logical response retried with another native run ID
cases.expected: Preserve one learner turn/attempt identity; additional run IDs remain dispatch metadata.

cases.scenario: Normalized transcript excerpt does not exactly match original capture
cases.expected: Preserve original and any explicit recognition revision; do not silently change snapshot text to satisfy verifier.

cases.scenario: User permits transcript retention but not raw audio retention
cases.expected: Retain exact permitted transcript with modality limitations; never claim a saved original voice file.

cases.scenario: Missing graph node treated as evidence of learner ignorance
cases.expected: Report system mapping gap, not a learner error or prerequisite diagnosis.

cases.scenario: Later answer supports a different cause than the first hypothesis
cases.expected: Keep counterevidence and update operational hypothesis/real assessment only under proper lineage.

cases.scenario: Two commands deliver the same review event after reconnect
cases.expected: One schedule update, one original attempt; duplicate transport is not another review.

cases.scenario: Scheduler policy changes after a past review
cases.expected: Preserve actual event/time/attempt history and record the new derived schedule/configuration.

cases.scenario: Model or visualization version changes without new learner evidence
cases.expected: Invalidate relevant generated views/context as appropriate; never automatically rewrite original judgments or create a new attempt.

cases.scenario: Gap-view grouping mixes hinted recall with unassisted application
cases.expected: Keep distinct performance/conditions and cite original episodes; no aggregate mastery claim.

cases.scenario: A prose summary is regenerated under the same source revision
cases.expected: Keep actual generation provenance; deterministic facts remain correct without claiming identical model wording.

cases.scenario: A summary repeats a subsequently retracted weakness
cases.expected: Invalidate/rebuild from effective assessments; summary does not resurrect old interpretation as new evidence.

cases.scenario: Generic run cleanup encounters full response referenced by an attempt
cases.expected: Treat referenced sidecar as durable evidence; approved retention/deletion must preserve or explicitly qualify dependencies.

cases.scenario: Initial archive exceeds the existing updater per-run batch cap
cases.expected: Maintain backlog and all-lecture frontier; continue only through owner-approved policy, without a duplicate publisher or unapproved schedule.

cases.scenario: Missing concept tree but original source/rubric is available
cases.expected: Answer from the available permitted original source with mapping limitation; do not force whole-archive completion first.

cases.scenario: New memory item exists but no workflow consumes its output
cases.expected: Registration/design validation flags the missing producer/consumer or classifies it intentionally inactive; file presence is not integration.
